sentiment: We carry less and remember more — the lightest machines hold the deepest grace.

stories.title: Saving 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1's DNS cache
stories.summary: One of the largest caches on earth trimmed by letting go of what it didn't need to hold. Precision isn't hoarding — it's knowing exactly what earns its space.

stories.title: Small Models Have Arrived
stories.summary: A quiet argument that smaller can be enough — that power and grace live in proportion, not in scale. The day's theme arrived twice, from two directions.

stories.title: 507 Mechanical Movements
stories.summary: A catalog of elegant machines, each drawn as pure idea — minimal strokes carrying maximal motion. Beauty as economy, drawn in ink.
